name: Campground and RV Park Operations
audience: independent campgrounds, RV parks, and small outdoor lodging properties
topic: site turnover, after-hours arrival, and cancellation-fill workflows

products.name: Campsite Turn Readiness
products.product: A focused campground campsite turnover readiness workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent campgrounds, RV parks, and small outdoor lodging properties
products.problem: Departed sites remain unavailable or are released too early because checkout, utilities, cleanup, damage, fire-ring or amenity checks, maintenance, and reservation status close separately.
products.valueProposition: Turns campground campsite turnover readiness into a visible operating queue so every departing site is inspected, serviced, reconciled, and released for the next arrival or held with a visible reason.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets campground site turnover, RV site inspection checklist, campsite cleaning tracker, and campground maintenance handoff searches.

products.name: After-Hours Arrival Handoff
products.product: A focused campground late arrival check in coordination workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent campgrounds, RV parks, and small outdoor lodging properties
products.problem: Guests arriving after the office closes may lack an updated site assignment, entry method, payment or agreement status, rig-specific directions, quiet-hours guidance, or a reachable escalation contact.
products.valueProposition: Turns campground late arrival check in coordination into a visible operating queue so every confirmed after-hours guest receives a current, secure arrival path tied to a ready site and a next-morning verification.
products.topic: campground late arrival check in coordination
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets campground late arrival, RV park after hours check in, campground lockbox instructions, and late check in workflow searches.

products.name: Cancellation Fill Queue
products.product: A focused campground cancellation waitlist fill tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent campgrounds, RV parks, and small outdoor lodging properties
products.problem: A desirable site reopens after cancellation, but waitlist preferences, rig fit, date flexibility, contact attempts, response deadlines, and released inventory are managed manually.
products.valueProposition: Turns campground cancellation waitlist fill tracking into a visible operating queue so every cancellation opportunity is offered to eligible waitlist guests in a fair visible sequence and returns to public inventory at a defined cutoff.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets campground waitlist software, RV park cancellation fill, campsite waitlist tracker, and campground vacancy alert searches.
